shortDescription: Daypark & Nightpark intelligence for Frequency 2026. Offline & Tactical.
longDescription:
Own the Green Park with Frequency Insider 2026.

From the afternoon rock sets at the Space Stage to the late-night beats in the Nightpark, this is your high-speed tactical guide to St. Pölten's biggest weekend.

FEATURES:
- FM4 Scout: Intelligent artist discovery curated for the Frequency vibe.
- Day/Night Toggle: Dedicated UI for switching between Daypark and Nightpark modes.
- Green Park Map: Pinpoint your position between the river and the stages.
- Survival Toolkit: Cashless links and essential tactical tools.
- Offline-First: Works perfectly during high-density network congestion.

Intelligence for the FM4 generation.
